verdict.rationale: Figma Make is itself an AI agent: its docs describe giving 'the agent' instructions to generate apps, which makes it the MCP client in this relationship. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The only MCP evidence (figma-make-docs-16) describes Make connecting out to external tools as context, which is client-side and does not show Make running as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
